meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: Claude会把产品链接、粘贴的脚本或简介做成产品发布/宣传视频:先抓取网址、分析品牌,再写脚本和分镜,最后生成视频。
howto.when: 当你要求给产品做宣传、发布或推广视频,或提供商业网址时触发;网站导览类请求也接入。

say.text: 把这个产品的落地页做成一支宣传视频。
say.note: Claude会抓取页面并开始制作。

say.text: 根据这段文案,给我们的新品做个发布视频。
say.note: 提供脚本后直接生成分镜。

say.text: 把我们的网站导览做成展示视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video: captures the site, analyzes the brand, writes script & storyboard, then generates the final video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, or promote a product, or provide a commercial URL; site tours also route here.

say_en.text: Turn this product landing page into a promo video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and starts production.

say_en.text: Make a launch video for our new product from this script.
say_en.note: Script provided; storyboard and frames follow.

say_en.text: Turn our site tour into a showcase video.
